What we do / Design

Design

Design at Narris gives strategy a form people can understand. We shape the structure of meaning, from narrative frameworks to the clarity of a report, so ideas are easy to follow and hard to misread.

Discuss this service Request a quotation

What our design work includes

  1. Narrative architecture frameworks

    The structure of meaning behind the organisation's communication.

  2. Publication architecture

    The structure, sequence and format of a body of publications.

  3. Executive narrative maps

    A single view of how leadership explains the organisation, and to whom.

  4. Positioning documents

    A written statement of position that teams and partners can share.

  5. Research synthesis documents

    Several sources brought together into one clear, well-structured account.
